# Frozen historical report examples

These are synthetic validator fixtures, not test-run evidence. They preserve
the Gate 3C/schema 2 and Gate 4A/schema 3 report shapes after the v04 Godot
product startup and report producers were retired. The old deck strings are
historical report values only; no player can select or load those decks.

The strict legacy validators still check every field and rejection case.
Only `--ci-product-smoke` reports from the actual v05 product may prove the
current game's UI works. Nothing in this directory is a gameplay result,
visual screenshot, package, CI success, or new-product acceptance claim.
